messages:
maya: FYI escalation from a private VPC customer — their billing shows ~12k tokens more than our meter and audit log. Customer says spikes coincide with a maintenance window last night. :thinking:
raj: Can you paste the customer's agent id and the time window?
maya: agent_id=onprem-gtw-3321, window=2026-03-15T01:10:00Z .. 2026-03-15T02:00:00Z. They attached CSV of audit events vs meter counts.
henry: Quick suspicion: heartbeat/seq gaps + offline buffering replay created duplicate replay submissions. Had a similar one with older agent versions. Which agent version?
maya: agent v2.4.1 (deployed 2025-11). They said they restarted the agent during the maintenance.
ops-bot: [alert] agent onprem-gtw-3321 reported 2 heartbeat misses and 1 force-restart at 2026-03-15T01:23:12Z
raj: can we get the agent logs for that timeframe? also NTP/clock skew info from the host. If clock jumped forward then back during restart, that could make replay timestamps overlap and double-count when the meter ingests replayed events.
maya: pasted log snippet from customer (redacted):
```
2026-03-15T01:23:10Z INFO buffering_event seq=143291 size=512
2026-03-15T01:23:12Z WARN heartbeat_miss count=1
2026-03-15T01:23:12Z INFO agent_restart initiated_by=system
2026-03-15T01:23:14Z INFO replay_flush start seq=143291 end_seq=143320
2026-03-15T01:23:14Z INFO emit_event seq=143291 token_count=34
2026-03-15T01:23:14Z INFO emit_event seq=143292 token_count=18
... (replayed 30 events) ...
2026-03-15T01:23:16Z INFO ingest_ack seq=143291 status=ok
2026-03-15T01:23:17Z INFO ingest_ack seq=143291 status=ok  # duplicate ack
```
henry: duplicate ack lines look suspicious. Our ingest should be deduped by (agent_id, seq) but if sequence numbers were reset or timestamps skewed the ingestion window might accept duplicates. Any chance agent restarted and seq counter reset?
maya: customer says they saw seq jump backward briefly after restart.
raj: ask them for the agent state file (seq pointer) and the audit export. I want to check whether the agent created two batches with overlapping seq ranges. Also check the private broker logs for duplicate ingestion receipts.
ops-bot: [command] run: curl -X GET "https://private-ingest.internal/v1/metrics?agent=onprem-gtw-3321&from=2026-03-15T01:10:00Z&to=2026-03-15T02:00:00Z"
henry: replayed events will create meter entries and also be in audit log; the customer's CSV showing meter > audit suggests some events were counted but not present in audit -> implies ingestion path accepted events that were later lost from audit store or audit timestamps were rewritten. Could be partial replay + partial dedupe failure.
maya: customer ran verify script and saw ~120 events in meter not in audit. token delta ~12,400.
raj: next steps I recommend to customer (short): 1) provide agent state file and full logs for 01:10-02:00 2) export broker ingest logs for same window 3) confirm host NTP history (chrony/ntpd logs) 4) don't rotate or restart agent until we correlate.
henry: internal mitigation: temporarily enable strict dedupe layer on private broker for that customer (reject duplicates by (agent_id,seq) for 24h) and flag their billing to hold charges pending reconciliation. Ops, can we do a one-time backfill reconciliation? @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: I can flip strict-dedupe in the private broker config for their tenant. Will throttle to avoid backpressure. Also hold invoices for that tenant.
maya: customer is OK with holding invoice. They asked if we can provide a reconciliation script they can run locally to compare audit vs meter (they want to validate before we apply credits).
raj: send this snippet to them to compute set difference locally:
```
# python pseudo
meter_seqs = set(read_csv('meter.csv')['seq'])
audit_seqs = set(read_csv('audit.csv')['seq'])
missing = meter_seqs - audit_seqs
print(len(missing), sum(tokens_for(seq) for seq in missing))
```
maya: sent snippet. Customer will provide more logs by EOD.
henry: long-term: add sequence-wrap detection in agent (if seq drops by >1000 within 5s, stamp a new epoch id) and include epoch in digest to avoid cross-epoch dupes. I'll file a ticket to eng-runtime.
raj: also add a telemetry event when agent issues replay_flush so we can correlate replay windows to invoice spikes.
maya: filing done: INC-2026-4423 (holding invoice, strict dedupe enabled for tenant, awaiting logs).
ops-bot: [note] ticket INC-2026-4423 created by maya at 2026-03-15T10:05:00Z
maya: thanks team. I'll follow up with customer once we get their logs and broker export. :thumbsup:
